name: Jesus
bio: Jesus Christ, descended from Abraham and David through Joseph's line, was conceived by the Holy Spirit and born to Mary while she was engaged to Joseph. An angel instructed Joseph to name him Jesus, "for he will save his people from their sins," fulfilling the ancient prophecy of a virgin-born son called Immanuel, "God with us" (Matthew 1:1-25). His birth, ministry, death, and resurrection are told in full across the four Gospels. Herod the Great, troubled by reports of a newborn King of the Jews, ordered the massacre of young boys in Bethlehem after wise men following a star came seeking him; Joseph, warned by an angel, had already fled with Mary and the infant Jesus to Egypt, returning to settle in Nazareth only after Herod's death (Matthew 2:1-23).
